Name: Primary Button
Purpose: The one action the screen wants taken; at most one per view
Visual Rules: bg: component.button.primary.bg; fg: component.button.primary.fg; radius: semantic.radius.control; outline: semantic.outline.control + colorRule; shadow: component.button.primary.shadow; height: component.button.primary.height; font: semantic.typography.label with fontSize component.button.primary.fontSize weight 700; paddingX: component.button.primary.paddingX; minWidth: component.button.primary.minWidth
Variants: default | with-leading-icon | with-trailing-icon | full-width | loading
States: default | hover (semantic.state.hover) | pressed (semantic.state.pressed: translateY offsetY, bg primaryPressed) | focus (semantic.state.focus ring) | disabled (semantic.state.disabled opacity, no shadow) | loading (primitive.opacity.loading, spinner replaces label, width locked)
Interaction: tap/click fires on release inside bounds; press-in on pointer-down; duration primitive.duration.fast; easing primitive.easing.standard; haptic light on mobile
Platform Notes: iOS: height >= touchTarget.min 44pt; Android: 48dp, ripple bounded to radius; web: cursor pointer, focus-visible ring, Enter/Space activate
Anti Patterns: two primary buttons in one view | label longer than 24 chars | icon-only without accessible name | opacity-only disabled on coloured backgrounds
QA Criteria: contrast fg/bg >= 4.5:1 | height matches token exactly | pressed state visibly different within 100ms | disabled not focusable but readable
Code Reuse Hint: one Button component with variant prop {primary,secondary,destructive,icon}; never a second class for 'big button'

Name: Secondary Button
Purpose: Alternative or lower-priority action next to a primary
Visual Rules: bg: component.button.secondary.bg; fg: component.button.secondary.fg; outline: component.button.secondary.outlineWidth / outlineColor; radius: semantic.radius.control; shadow: component.button.secondary.shadow; height and paddingX identical to button.primary
Variants: default | with-icon | full-width | ghost (bg transparent, outline none, app only)
States: default | hover (bg component.button.secondary.bgHover) | pressed (bg bgPressed + state.pressed offset) | focus | disabled
Interaction: same as button.primary; never auto-focused
Platform Notes: iOS/Android: same minimum sizes as primary; web: keyboard order primary first, secondary second
Anti Patterns: secondary styled louder than primary | outline thinner than semantic.outline.control on game styles | ghost variant on game styles
QA Criteria: visually subordinate to primary at a glance | fg on bg >= 4.5:1 | identical height to primary when paired
Code Reuse Hint: same Button component, variant=secondary

Name: Icon Button
Purpose: Single-icon control for close, settings, back, mute
Visual Rules: size: component.button.icon.size (touchTarget.recommended); icon: primitive.iconSize.md; bg: component.button.icon.bg; fg: component.button.icon.fg; radius: component.button.icon.radius; outline/shadow: component.button.icon.*
Variants: plain (app) | raised (game: surface bg, outline, shadow sm) | toggled (bg primitive.color.brand.100)
States: default | hover | pressed (scale 0.94, duration.fast) | focus | disabled | toggled
Interaction: tap; long-press shows overlay.tooltip (app) or nothing (game); toggle variants announce state
Platform Notes: iOS: 44pt hit area even if glyph is 24; Android: 48dp; web: aria-label required, tooltip on hover
Anti Patterns: hit area smaller than the visual size | icon from a second icon library | emoji as icon
QA Criteria: accessible name present | hit area >= touchTarget.min | glyph centred within 1 unit
Code Reuse Hint: Button variant=icon; glyph from the single icon set named in VDP.iconography.library_hint

Name: Destructive Button
Purpose: Irreversible or data-losing action (delete, reset progress, sign out everywhere)
Visual Rules: bg: semantic.color.danger; fg: semantic.color.onDanger; outline: semantic.outline.control with colour primitive.color.danger.700 when colorRule=fill.700; radius/height/padding: as button.primary; shadow: as button.primary with danger ramp
Variants: filled | outline (fg danger, outline danger, bg surface) | text-only (app lists)
States: default | hover (primitive.color.danger.700) | pressed (danger.800) | focus | disabled
Interaction: always behind confirm.destructive unless the action is undoable within 5 s (then toast with Undo)
Platform Notes: iOS: red text in action sheets is the platform idiom; Android: outline variant in dialogs; web: never the default-focused button in a dialog
Anti Patterns: destructive placed where primary normally sits | danger colour reused for non-destructive emphasis | auto-focus on destructive
QA Criteria: onDanger contrast >= 4.5:1 | confirm step present or undo available | never the first tab stop in a dialog
Code Reuse Hint: Button variant=destructive; colour comes from semantic.color.danger only

Name: Card
Purpose: Groups one entity (item, level, transaction) with its actions
Visual Rules: bg: component.card.bg; radius: component.card.radius (semantic.radius.container); padding: component.card.padding; border: component.card.borderWidth / borderColor; shadow: component.card.shadow (semantic.elevation.raised); internal gap: component.card.gap
Variants: static | interactive (whole card tappable, hover elevation semantic.elevation.elevated) | selected (outline semantic.color.primary) | media-top
States: default | hover (interactive only) | pressed (interactive only, state.pressed) | selected | disabled
Interaction: interactive cards: single tap target, no nested buttons except an explicit action row
Platform Notes: iOS: no hover; Android: ripple on interactive; web: whole-card link uses one anchor, inner actions stop propagation
Anti Patterns: shadow on resting cards when elevation.method=tint | nested cards | card radius larger than popup radius
QA Criteria: radius equals semantic.radius.container exactly | one elevation method per screen | padding from the spacing scale
Code Reuse Hint: Card(variant, selected, onTap) wrapper; content slots header/body/footer

Name: Panel
Purpose: Full-width section container on a screen (settings group, level-select panel, shop section)
Visual Rules: bg: semantic.color.surface; radius: semantic.radius.container on mobile, none when edge-to-edge; padding: semantic.spacing.inset; gap: semantic.spacing.stack; divider: primitive.outline.thin in semantic.color.border; title: semantic.typography.title
Variants: grouped (rounded inset) | edge-to-edge | collapsible
States: default | collapsed | expanded | disabled
Interaction: collapse toggles with duration.base and easing.standard; content height animates
Platform Notes: iOS: grouped inset style maps to insetGrouped list; Android: Material card-less section with headers; web: section element with heading
Anti Patterns: panels inside panels beyond 2 levels | different radius from card.default without an exception
QA Criteria: section heading present | spacing from tokens only | collapse respects reduced motion
Code Reuse Hint: Panel(title, collapsible) composes list.item children

Name: Modal Dialog
Purpose: Blocking decision or short form that must be resolved before continuing
Visual Rules: bg: component.popup.bg; radius: component.popup.radius; padding: component.popup.padding; shadow: component.popup.shadow; scrim: component.popup.scrim; maxWidth: component.popup.maxWidth; outline: component.popup.outlineWidth / outlineColor (game); title: semantic.typography.title; zIndex: primitive.zIndex.popup
Variants: info (one button) | decision (secondary + primary) | form (inputs + actions) | fullscreen (mobile app only)
States: entering (duration.base, easing.enter, scale 0.95 -> 1 + fade) | open | leaving (duration.fast, easing.exit) | busy (actions disabled)
Interaction: scrim tap closes only info variant; Escape closes on web/desktop; focus trapped; initial focus on first non-destructive action
Platform Notes: iOS: sheet idiom preferred for forms (see sheet.bottom); Android: Material dialog, buttons right-aligned; web: role=dialog, aria-modal, focus trap
Anti Patterns: stacking two modals | modal without a way to dismiss | primary button on the left
QA Criteria: focus trapped and restored on close | scrim uses semantic.color.overlay | width <= maxWidth and >= 280 on mobile
Code Reuse Hint: one Dialog component; popup.* game variants (pause/win/lose/confirm/offer) reuse its shell

Name: Bottom Sheet
Purpose: Non-blocking tasks, pickers and filters anchored to the bottom edge
Visual Rules: bg: semantic.color.surfaceElevated; radius: semantic.radius.popup on top corners only; handle: 36 x 4 pill in semantic.color.border; padding: component.popup.padding; shadow: semantic.elevation.floating; scrim: semantic.color.overlay; zIndex: primitive.zIndex.overlay
Variants: modal (scrim) | persistent (no scrim, peek height) | full-height
States: collapsed (peek) | expanded | dragging | dismissing
Interaction: drag handle and content drag; snap points at peek/half/full; swipe down dismisses; duration.slow with easing.standard on snap
Platform Notes: iOS: respects safe area bottom inset; Android: Material bottom sheet, back closes; web: converts to dialog.modal above 768px width
Anti Patterns: sheet taller than 90% viewport without full-height variant | content scroll fighting sheet drag | missing safe-area padding
QA Criteria: handle visible and >= 24 tall hit area | snap animation <= duration.slow | keyboard pushes sheet up on inputs
Code Reuse Hint: BottomSheet with snapPoints prop; shares shell styling with dialog.modal

Name: Top App Bar
Purpose: Screen title, back/close and up to two contextual actions
Visual Rules: height: 56 (app) in platform unit; bg: semantic.color.surface; title: semantic.typography.title at fontSize primitive.fontSize.lg; actions: button.icon; divider: primitive.outline.thin in semantic.color.border when content scrolled; zIndex: primitive.zIndex.sticky
Variants: default | large-title (collapses on scroll) | transparent-over-media | search
States: default | scrolled (divider or elevation.raised) | collapsed large-title
Interaction: back/close on the leading edge; actions trailing; title not tappable
Platform Notes: iOS: navigation bar with large title option, back chevron + previous title; Android: top app bar, back arrow, overflow menu; web: sticky header, skip link before it
Anti Patterns: more than two trailing actions | title truncation without tooltip on web | custom back icon
QA Criteria: height from token | safe-area top inset applied | title contrast >= 4.5:1
Code Reuse Hint: AppBar(title, leading, actions) using button.icon for actions

Name: Tabs
Purpose: Switch between sibling views of the same screen
Visual Rules: height: 48; indicator: 3 units high in semantic.color.primary with radius primitive.radius.full; label: semantic.typography.label; active fg: semantic.color.primary; inactive fg: semantic.color.textMuted; bg: semantic.color.surface; divider: primitive.outline.thin semantic.color.border
Variants: fixed (2-4 equal width) | scrollable (5+) | segmented (app, pill container)
States: default | active | hover | pressed | focus | disabled
Interaction: tap switches; swipe between panels on mobile; indicator slides duration.base easing.standard
Platform Notes: iOS: segmented control idiom for <= 3 tabs; Android: Material tabs; web: role=tablist, arrow-key navigation
Anti Patterns: tabs as a navigation bar between screens | icons without labels in fixed tabs | more than 5 fixed tabs
QA Criteria: active tab distinguishable without colour alone (indicator) | touch target >= touchTarget.min | indicator motion respects reduced motion
Code Reuse Hint: Tabs(items, value, onChange); indicator position derived, not hard-coded

Name: Menu
Purpose: Short list of commands anchored to a trigger (overflow, context, dropdown)
Visual Rules: bg: semantic.color.surfaceElevated; radius: semantic.radius.container; padding: primitive.spacing.2; item height: 44 (app) / 56 (game); item label: semantic.typography.body; destructive item fg: semantic.color.danger; shadow: semantic.elevation.floating; minWidth: 180; zIndex: primitive.zIndex.popup
Variants: dropdown | context (long-press / right-click) | overflow
States: closed | opening (duration.fast, easing.enter, origin at trigger) | open | item-hover | item-pressed | item-disabled
Interaction: opens on tap/click of trigger; closes on outside tap, Escape, or selection; keyboard arrows move focus
Platform Notes: iOS: UIMenu idiom with icons trailing; Android: Material menu; web: role=menu with menuitem, focus returns to trigger
Anti Patterns: menus with more than 8 items (use sheet or page) | icons mixed with icon-less items | destructive item not last
QA Criteria: focus management verified | item hit area >= touchTarget.min | menu never clipped by viewport
Code Reuse Hint: Menu(trigger, items) reusing list.item for rows

Name: Loading State
Purpose: Content is being fetched or computed; keeps layout stable
Visual Rules: skeleton blocks: bg primitive.color.neutral.200 with shimmer to neutral.100, radius semantic.radius.tile, duration 1200ms linear loop; spinner: 24 (app) / 40 (game) in semantic.color.primary, stroke primitive.outline.strong; inline loading on buttons uses primitive.opacity.loading
Variants: skeleton (lists, cards) | spinner (short, unknown layout) | inline (button) | full-screen (first launch only)
States: idle | loading (> 300ms before showing) | timed-out (> 10 s shows state.error with retry)
Interaction: non-interactive; shows after a 300ms delay to avoid flicker; replaced in place without layout shift
Platform Notes: iOS: UIActivityIndicator acceptable for spinner variant; Android: circular progress; web: aria-busy on the region, prefers-reduced-motion disables shimmer
Anti Patterns: spinner for list content (use skeleton) | loading overlay that blocks the whole app | multiple spinners on one screen
QA Criteria: no layout shift when content arrives | shimmer stops under reduced motion | timeout path reaches state.error
Code Reuse Hint: LoadingState(variant) + Skeleton primitive; same spinner component used by buttons

Name: Empty State
Purpose: Nothing to show yet; explains why and offers the next step
Visual Rules: illustration: primitive.iconSize.xl or asset per asset-guidelines, max 160 tall; title: semantic.typography.title; body: semantic.typography.body in semantic.color.textMuted; action: button.primary or button.secondary; vertical gap: semantic.spacing.stack; centred in available area with padding semantic.spacing.section
Variants: first-use (with primary action) | no-results (search/filter, secondary action 'clear filters') | all-done (celebratory, game may use reward colour)
States: default | with-action | compact (inside panels, no illustration)
Interaction: action button navigates or clears; no auto-dismiss
Platform Notes: iOS/Android: respects keyboard avoidance when inside a search screen; web: heading level follows page outline
Anti Patterns: empty state that looks like an error | illustration taller than 40% of viewport | jokes in error-adjacent empties
QA Criteria: copy explains cause + next step | contrast of textMuted >= 4.5:1 | action reachable without scroll on 375 wide
Code Reuse Hint: EmptyState(illustration, title, body, action)

Name: Error State
Purpose: Something failed; says what, whether it is the user's fault, and how to recover
Visual Rules: icon: primitive.iconSize.lg in semantic.color.danger; title: semantic.typography.title; body: semantic.typography.body; container (inline variant): bg primitive.color.danger.50, outline primitive.outline.thin in primitive.color.danger.200, radius semantic.radius.container, padding semantic.spacing.inset; action: button.secondary 'Retry'
Variants: inline (field/section) | full-area (replaces content) | banner (top of screen, dismissible)
States: default | retrying (action shows state.loading inline) | resolved (fades out duration.base)
Interaction: retry re-runs the failed call; banner dismiss persists for the session
Platform Notes: iOS/Android: never a native alert for recoverable errors; web: role=alert for banner, aria-describedby from field to inline error
Anti Patterns: red text only, no icon or title | technical error codes as the headline | blocking modal for a retryable network error
QA Criteria: danger colour from semantic.color.danger only | retry path tested | error announced to screen readers
Code Reuse Hint: ErrorState(variant, onRetry); inline variant shared with input.text error message

Name: Success State
Purpose: Confirms a completed action without stealing the screen
Visual Rules: icon: primitive.iconSize.lg in semantic.color.success; container (inline): bg primitive.color.success.50, outline primitive.outline.thin primitive.color.success.200, radius semantic.radius.container; toast variant uses toast; full-area variant: title semantic.typography.title, body textMuted, action button.primary
Variants: inline (after a form) | toast (transient, see toast) | full-area (checkout done, level cleared handled by popup.win in games)
States: entering (duration.base, easing.enter, check draws in) | visible | auto-dismiss (toast only)
Interaction: no interaction required; full-area variant offers one next action
Platform Notes: iOS/Android: haptic success on full-area; web: role=status for inline/toast
Anti Patterns: confetti or sound on routine saves (app) | success green reused for links or buttons | success copy that repeats the action text
QA Criteria: onSuccess contrast >= 4.5:1 | icon + text, never colour alone | motion <= duration.slow
Code Reuse Hint: SuccessState(variant) sharing the inline shell with state.error

Name: Disabled State
Purpose: A control exists but is not actionable right now; must explain why when possible
Visual Rules: opacity: semantic.state.disabled.opacity on the whole control; shadow: primitive.shadow.none; outline keeps width; cursor not-allowed on web; helper text in semantic.color.textMuted when a reason exists
Variants: control-level | section-level (panel dimmed + lock icon) | locked (game: lock badge instead of opacity, see nav.level-node)
States: disabled | disabled-with-reason (tooltip or helper text)
Interaction: not focusable via tab on web (aria-disabled when the reason must be readable); taps do nothing, no error toast
Platform Notes: iOS: isEnabled=false; Android: enabled=false with Material disabled alpha; web: disabled attribute or aria-disabled
Anti Patterns: opacity so low the label is unreadable | disabled used to hide features (hide instead) | disabled without any hint of how to enable
QA Criteria: label still >= 3:1 contrast at disabled opacity | no shadow or elevation while disabled | reason surfaced where feasible
Code Reuse Hint: a shared disabled modifier on every interactive component, never per-component colours

Name: Text Input
Purpose: Single-line text entry with label, helper and error
Visual Rules: height: 44 (app, touchTarget.min on mobile); bg: semantic.color.surface; outline: primitive.outline.thin semantic.color.border, focus primitive.outline.regular semantic.color.primary + ring semantic.state.focus; radius: semantic.radius.control; paddingX: primitive.spacing.3; text: semantic.typography.body; label: semantic.typography.label; helper/error: semantic.typography.caption in textMuted / semantic.color.danger
Variants: default | with-leading-icon | with-trailing-action (clear, visibility) | multiline | search (chip radius)
States: default | hover (border neutral.400) | focus | filled | error (outline danger, helper danger) | disabled (bg neutral.100) | read-only
Interaction: focus shows ring; clear action appears when filled; error clears on next valid input; Enter submits single-field forms
Platform Notes: iOS: keyboard type and textContentType set; Android: IME action set, Material outlined style; web: label element bound, autocomplete attribute, 16px font minimum to prevent zoom
Anti Patterns: placeholder as the only label | error shown before first blur | height below touchTarget.min on mobile
QA Criteria: label visible and bound | error state readable without colour (icon or text) | focus ring visible on all backgrounds
Code Reuse Hint: TextField(label, helper, error, leading, trailing); error row shared with state.error inline

Name: Count Badge
Purpose: Small numeric count on an icon or tab (unread, items, lives)
Visual Rules: min size: 18 (app) / 24 (game); bg: semantic.color.danger (notifications) or semantic.color.accent (counts); fg: matching onX; radius: primitive.radius.full; font: semantic.typography.caption weight 700; paddingX: primitive.spacing.1; outline: primitive.outline.regular in semantic.color.surface so it separates from the icon; offset: top-right, overlapping by 25%
Variants: count (1-99, then 99+) | dot (no number) | game-resource (accent bg, icon + count)
States: hidden (0) | visible | updating (scale 1 -> 1.2 -> 1, duration.fast, easing.emphasized)
Interaction: non-interactive; parent control carries the tap
Platform Notes: iOS: tab bar badge idiom; Android: Material badge; web: aria-label on parent includes the count
Anti Patterns: badge wider than its parent icon | count without the parent having an accessible name | badge colour used for decoration
QA Criteria: 99+ cap enforced | contrast fg/bg >= 4.5:1 | separation outline visible on dark and light surfaces
Code Reuse Hint: Badge(count|dot) attached via a wrapper, not positioned per call-site

Name: Tooltip
Purpose: Short label or hint on hover/long-press/focus; never essential information
Visual Rules: bg: primitive.color.neutral.900 (light) / neutral.100 (dark theme); fg: inverse text; radius: semantic.radius.control; padding: primitive.spacing.2 primitive.spacing.3; font: semantic.typography.caption; maxWidth: 240; arrow optional 8 wide; zIndex: primitive.zIndex.toast; shadow: semantic.elevation.floating
Variants: plain | rich (title + body, app only) | game-hint (surface bg, outline, points at a HUD element)
States: hidden | showing (delay 400ms hover, immediate on focus, duration.fast fade) | visible | hiding
Interaction: hover/focus (web, desktop); long-press (mobile); dismiss on blur, pointer leave, Escape; never traps focus
Platform Notes: iOS: long-press only, rarely used; Android: long-press tooltip; web: role=tooltip, aria-describedby, must not be the only way to learn a control's name
Anti Patterns: tooltips with actions inside | essential instructions only in tooltips | tooltips on touch-only controls without a long-press affordance
QA Criteria: shows on keyboard focus | disappears on Escape | never clipped by viewport edges
Code Reuse Hint: Tooltip(content, placement) wrapping the trigger; positioning engine shared with menu.list

Name: Notification Indicator
Purpose: Dot or pulse marking new content on an entry point (tab, icon, level node)
Visual Rules: size: 8 (app) / 12 (game) dot; bg: semantic.color.danger for attention, semantic.color.reward for rewards available; outline: primitive.outline.regular in parent bg; pulse: scale 1 -> 1.6 fade-out, 1200ms, max 3 cycles, disabled under reduced motion; position: top-right of parent
Variants: dot | pulse | new-label (small pill 'NEW' in accent, game)
States: hidden | visible | pulsing (first 3 s only)
Interaction: non-interactive; cleared when the parent is opened
Platform Notes: iOS/Android: pulse respects reduce-motion settings; web: aria-live polite announcement when it appears
Anti Patterns: permanent pulsing | more than 3 indicators visible on one screen | indicator colour used elsewhere for non-alerts
QA Criteria: clears after visit | pulse cycle count capped | dot visible on both light and dark parents
Code Reuse Hint: NotificationDot(variant) attached through the same wrapper as badge.count

Name: Toast
Purpose: Brief non-blocking confirmation or notice, optionally with one action
Visual Rules: bg: primitive.color.neutral.900 (app) / semantic.color.surfaceElevated with outline (game); fg: inverse text / semantic.color.text; radius: semantic.radius.container; padding: primitive.spacing.3 primitive.spacing.4; font: semantic.typography.body; action: text button in semantic.color.accent; shadow: semantic.elevation.floating; zIndex: primitive.zIndex.toast; width: min(viewport - 2*screenGutter, 480); position: bottom above nav bars
Variants: info | success (leading check icon in semantic.color.success) | error (danger icon, longer duration) | with-action (Undo)
States: entering (slide up duration.base easing.enter) | visible (4 s info, 6 s with action, 8 s error) | leaving (fade duration.fast) | paused (hover/focus holds timer)
Interaction: swipe down dismisses; action fires once and dismisses; only one toast visible, newest replaces
Platform Notes: iOS: no native idiom, custom view above safe area; Android: Material snackbar rules; web: role=status (info/success) or role=alert (error)
Anti Patterns: toast for errors that need a decision | stacking toasts | toast covering the primary button
QA Criteria: auto-dismiss timing per variant | action reachable by keyboard | does not cover the primary action
Code Reuse Hint: single Toast host at app root; feedback.toast (game rows) reuses it with the game skin

Name: Destructive Confirmation
Purpose: Second step before an irreversible action; names the object and the consequence
Visual Rules: shell: dialog.modal decision variant; icon: primitive.iconSize.lg in semantic.color.danger; title: semantic.typography.title naming the object; body: consequence in semantic.typography.body; actions: button.secondary 'Cancel' (initial focus) + button.destructive with the verb ('Delete 3 items')
Variants: simple (two buttons) | typed-confirmation (user types the name, app) | with-checkbox ('Also delete attachments')
States: open | busy (destructive button loading, cancel disabled) | done (closes, toast with result)
Interaction: Cancel on Escape/back; destructive requires an explicit tap; no auto-confirm on Enter
Platform Notes: iOS: action sheet idiom acceptable for short lists; Android: dialog with destructive button right-most; web: focus starts on Cancel
Anti Patterns: destructive as the default/focused action | generic 'Are you sure?' without naming the object | confirmation for undoable actions
QA Criteria: initial focus on Cancel verified | button label contains the verb and object | busy state blocks double submit
Code Reuse Hint: Dialog + Button(destructive) composition; a helper confirmDestructive(object, verb, onConfirm)

Name: List Item
Purpose: Row in a list: leading visual, primary + secondary text, trailing value or control
Visual Rules: height: 56 single-line / 72 two-line (app); 64 (game); bg: semantic.color.surface; divider: primitive.outline.thin semantic.color.border inset to text start; leading: primitive.iconSize.md or 40 avatar; primary: semantic.typography.body; secondary: semantic.typography.caption in textMuted; trailing: caption, chip.filter, switch or chevron; paddingX: semantic.spacing.inset; gap: primitive.spacing.3
Variants: one-line | two-line | with-avatar | with-switch | navigational (chevron) | selectable (checkbox)
States: default | hover | pressed (bg primitive.color.neutral.100) | selected (bg primitive.color.brand.50, leading check) | disabled | swiped (reveals actions, app)
Interaction: whole row tappable; trailing control owns its own tap; swipe reveals at most two actions
Platform Notes: iOS: disclosure chevron for navigation, swipe actions idiom; Android: Material list item, ripple; web: role=listitem or button when actionable
Anti Patterns: two tap targets with no visual separation | secondary text longer than two lines | dividers edge-to-edge and inset mixed in one list
QA Criteria: height from token | divider inset consistent | selected state visible without colour alone
Code Reuse Hint: ListItem(leading, title, subtitle, trailing, onTap); menu.list and panel.container compose it

Name: Filter Chip
Purpose: Toggleable filter or category selector in a horizontal row
Visual Rules: height: 32 (app) / 40 (game); bg: semantic.color.surface, selected primitive.color.brand.100; fg: semantic.color.text, selected semantic.color.primary; outline: primitive.outline.thin semantic.color.border, selected semantic.color.primary; radius: semantic.radius.chip; paddingX: primitive.spacing.3; font: semantic.typography.label; leading icon primitive.iconSize.sm optional; row gap primitive.spacing.2
Variants: single-select (radio semantics) | multi-select (checkbox semantics, check icon when selected) | with-count | dismissible (trailing x)
States: default | hover | pressed | selected | focus | disabled
Interaction: tap toggles; row scrolls horizontally with edge fade; selection change animates bg duration.fast
Platform Notes: iOS: segmented control for <= 3 single-select; Android: Material filter chip; web: role=checkbox/radio inside a group with a label
Anti Patterns: chips that navigate | more than 8 chips without a 'more' affordance | chip row that hides the selected chip off-screen
QA Criteria: selected distinguishable without colour alone | hit area >= touchTarget.min (vertical padding allowed) | row scroll works with keyboard
Code Reuse Hint: Chip(selected, onToggle, leading, trailing); hud.chip (game rows) is a separate read-only component

Name: Score Counter
Purpose: Show the running score during gameplay without competing with the constraint counter (moves/timer).
Visual Rules: plate fill: semantic.color.surface at >=85% opacity; stroke: shape.outline.width x0.66 with shape.outline.color_rule; radius: shape.radius_class one step tighter (tile radius); numerals: typography.display if tabular figures else typography.body bold, >=16dp; no rendering.shadow on HUD plates
Variants: digits-only | digits+label | digits+best-score sub-line
States: idle | incrementing (count-up <=250ms) | milestone (1.06 scale pulse, motion.duration_scale.fast) | hidden (kids learning)
Interaction: Non-interactive; tap on plate may open score details only outside timed modes.
Platform Notes: Flutter: Text with FontFeature.tabularFigures(); Flame: TextComponent on a HudComponent with priority >= board; Unity: TMP with monospace digit tag <mspace>; Web: font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums
Anti Patterns: Count-up longer than 1s hiding the real total | score larger than the moves/timer numerals | score plate casting a shadow over the board
QA Criteria: Numerals >=16dp and >=4.5:1 vs plate | final value visible within 250ms of a match | plate width stable for 6 digits (no jitter)
Code Reuse Hint: One HudPlate widget shared by hud.score, hud.moves, hud.timer, hud.currency; only the content slot differs

Name: Timer
Purpose: Show remaining time as a bar plus digits so the constraint is readable at a glance mid-move.
Visual Rules: bar 6-8dp tall, full plate width, radius: pill cap; fill: semantic.color.primary, switches to warning <20% and danger <10%; digits >=18dp on the shared HudPlate; stroke: shape.outline.width x0.66
Variants: bar+digits (default) | ring (sorting/merge energy) | digits-only (landscape side column)
States: running | warning (<20%, bar colour + audio tick) | critical (<10%, 1Hz digit blink + haptic each second) | paused (digits frozen, bar dimmed 60%) | expired (0:00, danger, shake 3dp)
Interaction: Non-interactive. Pause is a separate control (hud.pause-button); tapping the timer never pauses.
Platform Notes: Flutter: LinearProgressIndicator avoided (theme coupling), use custom painter; Flame: RectangleComponent width tween with Curves.linear; Unity: Image.fillAmount with Ease.Linear; Web: transform: scaleX on the fill, not width

Variants: info | error (danger icon, 4s, optional action) | success (check) | reward-mini (coin icon + amount)

Interaction: Non-interactive unless it carries one action (e.g. 'Undo'); never blocks board input; swipe-down dismisses on app, not during gameplay.
Platform Notes: Flutter: ScaffoldMessenger or overlay entry; Flame: HUD overlay component; Unity: pooled toast under the HUD canvas; Web: role=status (polite), aria-live
Anti Patterns: Toast over a popup | toast covering the moves/timer plate | stacking three toasts | toasts used for rewards that need a claim
QA Criteria: Below popups in z-order | not overlapping HUD plates or board | <=2 lines | 2s/4s duration
Code Reuse Hint: Toast component shared app/game; reward-mini reuses CurrencyIcon

Name: Shop Item Card
Purpose: Sell a pack/bundle/booster with contents visible, one price tag, and at most one badge.
Visual Rules: card radius: shape.radius_class; stroke: shape.outline.width; shading: rendering.shading; shadow: rendering.shadow; hero card may add rendering.highlight + ribbon; contents list of reward.card xs or icon+amount rows; price tag commerce.price-tag at the bottom, full card width minus 16dp; badge ('Best value' or 'Popular', max one of each in the shop) 20dp ribbon/corner chip; grid 2-3 columns, 8dp gap
Variants: currency-pack | booster | bundle/hero | remove-ads | subscription (with terms line)
States: idle | pressed (T0) | purchasing (price tag shows spinner) | owned (remove-ads: check + disabled) | limited (expiry chip, greys on expiry) | sold-out
Interaction: Tap card or price tag = platform purchase sheet (real money) or confirm popup (currency >=20% of balance). Expired cards never re-arm silently.
Platform Notes: iOS/Android: price string comes from the store product (localized); Flutter in_app_purchase ProductDetails.price; Unity IAP metadata.localizedPriceString; Web: Stripe/PSP formatted amount; Restore purchases link at shop bottom on iOS
Anti Patterns: Prices in different fonts/sizes across cards | contents behind an info icon | two 'Best value' badges | 'free' on items costing premium currency
QA Criteria: All price tags overlay-identical | <=1 Best value and <=1 Popular | contents visible without expanding | localized price string
Code Reuse Hint: ShopCard = Card base + reward.card list + commerce.price-tag

Name: Price Tag
Purpose: Display a price (real money or in-game currency) in one unmistakable component reused on every buy/continue/hint surface.
Visual Rules: pill (radius: pill) or shape.radius_class if the style is angular; height 32dp (small) / 44dp (large, tappable); fill: semantic.color.primary for currency, a documented second slot for real money if the palette defines one; stroke: shape.outline.width; text typography.body bold >=14dp (small) / 16dp (large); currency icon 16dp from CurrencyIcon left of the number; strikethrough old price only when previously sold
Variants: small (inside slots/buttons) | large (tappable button) | money | currency | ad ('Watch ad' with ad glyph) | free
States: idle | pressed (large only) | insufficient (danger outline + 'Get coins' routing) | loading (store price pending: skeleton, never '0') | discounted
Interaction: Large variant is the buy action itself; small variant is informational. Always visible before the action that spends.
Platform Notes: Never hardcode currency symbols; use store-localized strings for money; width must not change as digits grow beyond 5 characters (min-width)
Anti Patterns: Price inside an icon badge | price revealed after tap | mixed fonts across tags | '0' shown while loading
QA Criteria: Same size/font/radius on every screen (overlay test) | icon = HUD currency icon | min-width prevents jitter | insufficient state has a non-colour cue
Code Reuse Hint: PriceTag component used by hud.hint-button, hud.booster-slot, popup.lose, popup.offer, reward.wheel, commerce.shop-item

Name: Progress Bar
Purpose: Linear fill for timer, mission progress, level pre-sheet objectives, season pass and loading.
Visual Rules: height 6dp (lists) / 8dp (HUD timer) / 12dp (season pass with label inside); radius: pill caps; track semantic.color.border at 40%; fill semantic.color.primary (timer switches to warning <20%, danger <10% with non-colour cue); stroke shape.outline.width x0.5 if the style outlines everything; fill animates on transform scaleX, linear for timers, motion.duration_scale.base ease-out for discrete steps
Variants: plain | with-label | segmented (chapter steps) | ring (cooldown/energy, 3dp stroke)
States: empty | partial | full (optional 1-frame flash) | warning | danger | indeterminate (loading only)
Interaction: Non-interactive. Discrete updates animate from the previous value; the model value is applied first.
Platform Notes: Flutter: custom painter or FractionallySizedBox with Transform; Flame: RectangleComponent scale; Unity: Image.fillAmount; Web: transform: scaleX on the fill, transform-origin left
Anti Patterns: Width animation (layout) instead of transform | eased timer drain | colour-only warning
QA Criteria: Height one of 6/8/12dp | pill caps | fill colour from semantic slots | linear drain for timers
Code Reuse Hint: ProgressBar component reused by hud.timer, reward.mission-item, level pre-sheet, season pass

Name: Star Rating
Purpose: Show 0-3 earned stars for a level consistently on win, map nodes, pre-level sheet and profile.
Visual Rules: star glyph from one asset in two states (earned: semantic.color.reward fill + shape.outline.width stroke; empty: semantic.color.border fill at 60%); sizes 12dp (node), 20dp (pre-sheet), 48-64dp (win); gap = 1/6 of size; optional crown layout (middle star 12% larger, raised 4dp); shading: rendering.shading on the 48dp+ size only
Variants: 3-star | 5-star (anime RPG rarity) | crown-layout | score-threshold with labels
States: empty | earned-1/2/3 | animating (win: stagger per motion.class) | new-best (sparkle once, small tier)
Interaction: Non-interactive; on the pre-level sheet tapping stars shows thresholds.
Platform Notes: Flutter: Row of star widgets with a shared asset; Flame: SpriteComponent x3; Unity: prefab with three Images; Web: inline SVG with currentColor; never use text stars or emoji
Anti Patterns: Different star glyphs between win and map | emoji stars | earned/empty distinguishable only by colour
QA Criteria: Same glyph asset across win/map/profile captures | earned vs empty distinguishable in greyscale | sizes from {12,20,48,64}
Code Reuse Hint: StarRow component; win animation via EffectSequencer

Name: Hint Highlight
Purpose: Point at one valid move with a pulsing outline and optional hand without disturbing the rest of the board.
Visual Rules: outline shape.outline.width x1.5 in semantic.color.warning; pulse 2 cycles of motion.duration_scale.slow; optional hand 48dp per iconography.style; arrow/line for pairs uses accent at shape.outline.width + 1dp
Variants: outline-pulse | hand+outline | path-line (tile match)
States: pulsing | paused (a tile is selected) | stopped (first user tap) | static (reduced motion: steady outline)
Interaction: Stops on the first tap anywhere on the board; never consumes a second hint while active.
Platform Notes: Render in the effects layer (layer 4) above tiles, below HUD; Flame priority above tiles; Unity separate canvas
Anti Patterns: Hint highlighting a tile hidden under the HUD | pulse continuing after selection | same hue as selected
QA Criteria: Hue = warning slot, distinct from accent | stops on first tap | target fully visible
Code Reuse Hint: State of board.tile + shared pulse effect

Name: Shuffle / Cascade Lock Overlay
Purpose: Make the input-locked state visible while the board re-lays out.
Visual Rules: tiles fade to 50% then reposition then fade back (total <= 2x motion.duration_scale.slow); HUD shows a 'Shuffling...' plate (HudPlate) centred; boosters dimmed to 40%; no scrim over the board
Variants: shuffle | cascade/gravity | board-reset (restart)
States: locking | animating | unlocking (onComplete) | instant (static class / reduced motion: 150ms crossfade)
Interaction: All board taps ignored (no error sound); pause remains tappable.
Platform Notes: Unlock strictly on sequencer onComplete; Flutter: AnimationStatus.completed; Flame: SequenceEffect onComplete; Unity: DOTween OnComplete; Web: GSAP onComplete
Anti Patterns: Tappable tiles mid-shuffle | timer still running during shuffle in timed modes without the plate | overlay darker than 50%
QA Criteria: A tap during the sequence has no effect | 'Shuffling' plate visible | <=700ms total for bouncy class
Code Reuse Hint: EffectSequencer + HudPlate

Name: Streak Indicator
Purpose: Show the daily streak count and warn before it breaks.
Visual Rules: badge 32dp (lobby) / 48dp (popup) per illustration.character_style (flame/star); day count 20dp bold; 7-dot track 8dp dots gap 6dp with semantic.color.reward fill; freeze count chip if the mechanic exists; radius: shape.radius_class
Variants: lobby-badge | popup-track | banner-warning ('Play today to keep your 6-day streak')
States: active | at-risk (banner, once per day) | broken (recovery offer max once, continue-offer rules apply) | frozen
Interaction: Tap opens the streak popup; recovery offer has a real decline.
Platform Notes: Local-day boundary with server validation; share the number source with profile stats
Anti Patterns: Streak number differing between lobby and popup | recovery offer without a visible price | daily shaming copy
QA Criteria: Lobby and popup counts equal | 7 dots aligned | at-risk banner shown before loss, not only after
Code Reuse Hint: Badge + progress segmented variant
